episodes.title: Lost and Found
episodes.summary: A group of lawless teens, exiled on a mining colony outside Federation space, discover a derelict Starfleet ship. Dal must gather an unlikely crew for their newfound ship if they are going to escape Tars Lamora, but the Diviner and his daughter Gwyn have other plans.

episodes.title: Starstruck
episodes.summary: Even with the guidance of their hologram advisor Janeway, the crew of The Protostar is tested when their ship is on a dangerous cosmic collision course.

episodes.title: Dream Catcher
episodes.summary: The crew has their first away mission on an undiscovered planet that manifests their deepest desires, only to realize the planet has desires of its own.

episodes.title: Terror Firma
episodes.summary: Marooned on a deadly planet, the crew must work together with their captive Gwyn to stay alive…except the planet isn't the only thing in pursuit.

episodes.title: Kobayashi
episodes.summary: As Gwyn struggles to find her role aboard the U.S.S. Protostar, Dal tests his leadership skills in the newly discovered holodeck.

episodes.title: First Contact
episodes.summary: When a mentor from Dal's past persuades him to use their Federation cover for personal gain, they quickly discover Starfleet has protocols for a reason.

episodes.title: Time Amok
episodes.summary: When the U.S.S. Protostar is fractured in time by an anomaly, Hologram Janeway must synchronize the disjointed crew and save their ship before it destructs.

episodes.title: A Moral Star, Part 1
episodes.summary: The crew forgo their dreams of Starfleet to return to Tars Lamora in a no-win scenario.

episodes.title: A Moral Star, Part 2
episodes.summary: When the plan goes awry, the crew must improvise. Meanwhile, Gwyn discovers a dark truth that will forever jeopardize their quest toward salvation.

episodes.title: Asylum
episodes.summary: At the edge of Federation space, the crew applies for asylum at a comm relay outpost, only for their starship to reveal its shocking true purpose.

episodes.title: Let Sleeping Borg Lie
episodes.summary: When the crew encounters a dormant Borg Cube, Zero risks everything to save their ship.

episodes.title: All the World's a Stage
episodes.summary: The crew answers a distress call to find a colony trapped in Starfleet's past.

episodes.title: Crossroads
episodes.summary: When the crew attempts to secure transport to the Federation, they unwittingly cross paths with the Vice Admiral who is hunting them.

episodes.title: Masquerade
episodes.summary: Trapped in the Neutral Zone, the crew encounters a rogue geneticist who sheds light on Dal's past.

episodes.title: Preludes
episodes.summary: A Starfleet Admiral digs into the past of the Protostar crew. Meanwhile, the Diviner recalls his life's mission.

episodes.title: Ghost in the Machine
episodes.summary: When the crew gets trapped in the holodeck by a mysterious malfunction, they aren't sure what's programmed or what's real.

episodes.title: Mindwalk
episodes.summary: Desperate to warn Starfleet of their dilemma, a daring experiment goes awry as Dal inadvertently swaps minds with a Starfleet Vice Admiral.

episodes.title: Supernova, Part 1
episodes.summary: Surrounded by the Federation armada, the crew attempts to stop their ship from destroying all of Starfleet.

episodes.title: Supernova, Part 2
episodes.summary: As all looks lost, the young crew of the Protostar save the day at the very last moment.

episodes.title: Into the Breach, Part I
episodes.summary: Dal and his friends board Janeway's starship to investigate the wormhole created by the Protostar. Tired of his training, Dal longs for some action.

episodes.title: Into the Breach, Part II
episodes.summary: Gwyn runs into a familiar foe on the planet Solum. Janeway reveals the true stakes of their mission to Dal and his friends.

episodes.title: Who Saves the Saviors
episodes.summary: Traveling through the time rift, Dal and the crew search for Chakotay on Solum. With the support of her father, Gwyn challenges Asencia.

episodes.title: Temporal Mechanics 101
episodes.summary: Although separated by decades, the Infinity and the Voyager crews band together to save Gwyn's life. A mysterious messenger reaches out to Gwyn.

episodes.title: Observer's Paradox
episodes.summary: Reunited on the Voyager and under strict supervision, the gang must decode a secret message their mysterious benefactor left with Murf.

episodes.title: Imposter Syndrome
episodes.summary: Hoping to hijack the Infinity before its scheduled destruction, Dal and the crew create hologram doubles to cover for their absence.

episodes.title: The Fast and the Curious
episodes.summary: After using a Borg conduit to travel through time faster, Dal and his friends find themselves at the mercy of a demanding Kazon.

episodes.title: Is There in Beauty No Truth?
episodes.summary: The crew detours to a colony of non-corporeal entities, who offer Zero an opportunity to obtain a physical body. Janeway discovers Dal's real intentions.

episodes.title: The Devourer of All Things, Part I
episodes.summary: Finally arriving at the coordinates, the Infinity crew discovers a hidden planet – and the long-awaited identity of their mysterious messenger.

episodes.title: The Devourer of All Things, Part II
episodes.summary: On the run from their time-erasing pursuers, the Infinity crew and their new ally search for an escape. The Voyager embarks on a rescue mission.

episodes.title: Last Flight of the Protostar, Part I
episodes.summary: Thanks to Wesley Crusher's timely intervention, the cadets find the Protostar — but the ship's marooned guardian isn't eager for their assistance.

episodes.title: Last Flight of the Protostar, Part II
episodes.summary: Chakotay and the cadets devise a bold but perilous plan to relaunch the Protostar. Before the ship can fly, however, it will first have to sail.

episodes.title: A Tribble Called Quest
episodes.summary: While harvesting bosonite on a barren world that they need to proto-warp back to Voyager the crew encounters aggressive, genetically-modified tribbles — and the Klingon scientist who created them.

episodes.title: Cracked Mirror
episodes.summary: The Protostar's reunion with Voyager has unexpected side effects, bouncing the crew between alternate realities — including the Mirror Universe.

episodes.title: Ascension, Part I
episodes.summary: The Prodigy crew and Chakotay reunite with Voyager, bringing the timelost Protostar with them. But the past catches up to them when Ilthuran delivers a dire warning — Asencia is coming.

episodes.title: Ascension, Part II
episodes.summary: When Asencia's mysterious time weapon strikes Voyager and threatens all aboard, it's up to the crews of the Protostar, Voyager, and Nova Squadron to survive the attack.

episodes.title: Brink
episodes.summary: To prevent a war between the Federation and Solum, Gwyn leads the Protostar crew on a mission to rescue Ilthuran. But surprising discoveries force Gwyn to make hard choices which have dire consequences for everyone.

episodes.title: Touch of Grey
episodes.summary: Admiral Janeway devises a clever plan to liberate her crew from Asencia's prison, where they're trapped with an angry captive from the Loom.

episodes.title: Ouroboros, Part I
episodes.summary: Determined to save both Starfleet and Solum, the Prodigy crew must stop an invasion on the Federation and open the wormhole that will send the Protostar back to Tars Lamora.

episodes.title: Ouroboros, Part II
episodes.summary: To save the present and fix the past, our crew must face the Loom and pilot the Protostar through the temporal wormhole back to Tars Lamora. Even if they succeed, what will the future hold?
